statement: Every item has exactly one authoritative container; inventory is derived from it, never stored twice.
No proposed DomainEvent, Effect or projection hint is published when the decision is rejected, faults or its commit fails.
Two writer groups writing one mutation target without a registered composition rule fault with conflicting_write.
Every delta op's precondition holds against the overlay of the ops before it, or the decision faults.
No entity contains itself directly or transitively, and no container exceeds its capacity.
A budget, conflict or evaluator fault commits nothing: no state, receipt, RNG or time advance.
A fault DecisionResult carries only an evaluation_fault code from protocol/error_registry.json, never a gameplay rejection code.
Ambiguous candidate_ids are distinct and in the order the TargetResolution contract (protocol/action.schema.json) states.
An unregistered command, delta op, policy operator, event or effect type is invalid, never permissive.
CommandId depends only on the idempotency scope and InvocationId, never on routing or authority placement.

citation.heading: ### 5.0 Rejection is not a failed attempt

statement: A rejected decision changes no gameplay state, RNG, logical time or cost.
A retry with matching intent replays the original receipted outcome and never rerolls RNG or reruns effects.
Reusing an idempotency identity with a different semantic payload fails as an integrity conflict, with no mutation.
job.complete is proposed only by that job's own run_job at its visited due time (protocol/delta.schema.json job.complete).
